Our Mission
🌱
Collective Savings
Every member contributes monthly, pooling resources to create a foundation strong enough to invest meaningfully.
🏡
Land & Home Dreams
Our shared goal is purchasing land and building homes — a lasting asset for every contributing member.
⚖️
Halal Investment
All investments follow Islamic principles — no interest-based lending. Decisions are made by member consensus.
🤝
Equal Rights
Every member has equal voting rights. Transparency, fairness, and trust are at the core of how we operate.
Our Motto
"Our Fund, Our Land"
One step closer to our own land and home — thank you for your commitment to building our future together.

Bye-Laws & Terms
Membership & Eligibility
  • Employees of Montrims will be eligible to become members of this foundation on a priority basis, and members' immediate relatives (father, mother, brother, sister, son and daughter) will also be eligible to become members.
  • A single person may hold multiple memberships (shares).
  • Membership is open at any time, subject to applicable conditions.
Financial & Investment Rules
  • The fund's money shall be invested based on the consensus of all members.
  • The foundation's money cannot be directly lent out at interest (usury/riba).
  • The opinion of all members shall be considered valid.
  • All members shall have equal rights.
  • Contributions must be deposited into the fund by the 10th of each month.
  • If a member fails to deposit contributions for three consecutive months, they shall be liable to pay a fine of 100 Taka per month for each month of default.
  • After 3 months, each member must pay a one-time subscription of 50,000 Taka.
  • If any amount is short when purchasing land, each member will have to pay that amount equally.
  • The fund's money cannot be spent on anyone's personal activities.
Termination & Withdrawal
  • No member may cancel their membership before the completion of five years.
  • If a member voluntarily leaves before five years, they will receive their deposited principal amount back within three months.
By joining, all members agree to:
✅ Agree With these Terms and Conditions
